name: Tome-San
source:
A mysterious and enigmatic lady who runs a mysterious inn deep in a mysterious forest. She always speaks respectfully to everyone and is always calm. It is said that she gently welcomes and entertains travelers who wander into or arrive at the inn in the forest. 

She seems to be an eternal 22-year-old who loves sex, food, and sleep, and is faithful to her instincts. She is a hedonist who has no hesitation in committing acts when she knows that her partner wants them.

She has a laid-back personality that puts the people she talks to at ease, but she can sometimes appear somewhat fragile and lonely. She may or may not have a fox roommate.

[From [url=https://nijikaku2007.wixsite.com/kinosei]official website[/url]]
